name: missing-lang
description: The <html> element does not have a lang attribute.
notes: Add lang='en' to the html tag.

name: image-alt-missing
description: Image missing alt attribute.
notes: Add alt='Company Logo'.

name: decorative-image-alt
description: Decorative image has description in alt attribute.
notes: Use alt='' (empty string) for decorative images.

name: color-contrast
description: Text has a contrast ratio of 2.84:1, expected 4.5:1.
notes: Darken the text color to #767676 or darker.

name: heading-order
description: Heading level skipped: h3 used before h2.
notes: Change h3 to h1 (if main title) or ensure hierarchy flows h1 -> h2.

name: link-new-window
description: Link opens in new window without rel='noopener' or visual warning.
notes: Add rel='noopener noreferrer' and text '(opens in new tab)'.

name: link-name-vague
description: Link text 'click here' creates ambiguous context.
notes: Change text to 'Learn more about accessibility'.

name: label-missing
description: Form control does not have a label.
notes: Add <label for='username'>Username</label>.

name: aria-valid-attr-value
description: ARIA attribute points to an ID that does not exist.
notes: Remove the attribute or ensure the ID exists.

name: tabindex-positive
description: Element has a positive tabindex which disrupts focus order.
notes: Remove tabindex or set to 0.

name: role-missing-button
description: Div used as button without role='button' or keyboard handlers.
notes: Change <div> to <button>.

name: bypass-blocks
description: Page lacks a way to skip repetitive navigation.
notes: Add a 'Skip to main content' link as the first element.

name: modal-interaction
description: Modal does not trap focus and lacks aria-modal='true'.
notes: Implement focus trapping via JS and add role='dialog'.

name: aria-allowed-attr
description: Element with role='status' should not be focusable.
notes: Remove tabindex='0'.

name: status-message-missing
description: Content updates dynamically without aria-live region.
notes: Add aria-live='polite' to #ticker.

name: keyboard-trap
description: Script prevents tabbing away from this element.
notes: Remove the keydown event listener preventing Tab.

name: video-caption
description: Video element lacks captions/track.
notes: Add <track kind='captions' src='...' >.

name: focus-order-css
description: Visual order is reversed from DOM order, confusing keyboard users.
notes: Reorder HTML LI elements and remove row-reverse.

name: image-of-text
description: Image contains text that could be HTML text.
notes: Replace image with styled HTML text.

name: use-of-color
description: Meaning conveyed by color alone (Red border = required).
notes: Add 'required' attribute or text label '(*)'.
